description: Ghani Global Glass Limited is a Lahore-based glass manufacturer incorporated in October 2007 as Ghani Tableware (Private) Limited, renamed Ghani Global Glass Limited in 2009 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in December 2014 through a merger with Libas Textiles Limited. It makes glass tubes, glassware, vials, ampoules and chemicals, largely for the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries, at a plant on Lahore–Multan Road at Phool Nagar, District Kasur. It is a subsidiary of Ghani Global Holdings Limited.
sourceNote: Company website (ghaniglobalglass.com: our company, contact us) and the PSX Data Portal company record for GGGL, read 2026-10-17.
